user_stories.title: Implement UUID v4 generation module (ln_uuid)
acceptance_criteria: ln_uuid:new/0 generates RFC 4122 UUID v4 with 128 bits
ln_uuid:to_string/1 converts UUID to xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx format
ln_uuid:from_string/1 parses string format back to UUID binary
Property test: 10,000 UUIDs generated, all unique
Unit tests: UUID format validated (version 4, variant RFC 4122)
No dialyzer warnings
user_stories.notes: Foundation for all other features. Use crypto:strong_rand_bytes/1 for randomness.

user_stories.title: Update ln_effect to use UUID instead of make_ref
acceptance_criteria: effect_id type changed from reference() to ln_uuid:causal_id()
ln_effect:request/4 generates UUID via ln_uuid:new/0
ln_effect:get_receipts/1 returns receipts with UUID effect_id
Unit tests verify UUID in receipts
No dialyzer warnings
user_stories.notes: Bug fix: request/4 currently ignores input state and creates fresh state each time. This breaks effect state management. Must be fixed.

user_stories.title: Add idempotency_key to effect_spec and receipt
acceptance_criteria: effect_spec type includes optional idempotency_key field
ln_receipt record includes idempotency_key field
ln_receipt:storage record includes idempotency_index ETS table
ln_receipt:add/2 inserts into idempotency_index when key present
ln_receipt:lookup_by_key/3 finds receipt by {ScopeId, Key} tuple
Unit tests verify idempotency index lookup
user_stories.notes: Enables deduplication. Key is optional - effects without key execute every time.

user_stories.title: Implement idempotency check in ln_effect:request/4
acceptance_criteria: ln_effect:request/4 checks for existing receipt with matching idempotency_key
When receipt found: returns {ok, cached, Receipt, State}
When receipt not found: proceeds with effect creation
find_receipt_by_key/3 helper function scans receipts list
Property test: same idempotency_key returns cached result
Property test: different idempotency_keys create new effects
Unit tests verify state management bug fixed
user_stories.notes: Fixes the state management bug where request/4 ignored input state.

user_stories.title: Create ln_receipt_store gen_server for persistence
acceptance_criteria: ln_receipt_store:start_link/1 starts gen_server with log file path
DETS table opened at LogFile/receipts.dets
ETS cache table created for fast access
dets:to_ets/2 replays receipts into ETS on startup
ln_receipt_store:store/1 writes to DETS then ETS
ln_receipt_store:lookup/1 reads from ETS cache
ln_receipt_store:lookup_by_key/2 reads from ETS cache
Unit tests verify receipts persist across gen_server restart
Unit tests verify DETS file created in specified directory
user_stories.notes: DETS provides single-node persistence. Can migrate to Mnesia for distributed later.

user_stories.title: Integrate ln_receipt_store into ln_effect:complete/3
acceptance_criteria: ln_effect:complete/3 stores receipt via ln_receipt_store:store/1
Receipt includes idempotency_key from effect_spec
Unit tests verify receipt persisted to DETS
Integration test: store receipt, kill process, restart, receipt restored
user_stories.notes: Write-ahead logging: store to DETS before updating in-memory state.

user_stories.title: Add compensation function to effect_spec and receipt
acceptance_criteria: effect_spec type includes optional compensation fun field
ln_receipt type includes compensation field
ln_effect:complete/3 stores compensation from spec into receipt
Unit tests verify compensation function stored in receipt
user_stories.notes: Compensation is optional - effects without compensation cannot be undone.

user_stories.title: Implement compensation execution in cancel_effects/2
acceptance_criteria: ln_effect:cancel_effects/2 compensates completed effects in scope
compensate_effects/2 helper iterates receipts by scope_id
Calls compensation function with effect result
Logs error if compensation fails, continues with other effects
Returns list of compensated effects
Unit tests verify compensation function called
Unit tests verify compensation failure logged but doesn't block
user_stories.notes: Integrates with ln_cancel hierarchical scope cancellation.

user_stories.title: Create wf_effect_handler gen_server for async execution
acceptance_criteria: wf_effect_handler:start_link/1 starts process for single effect
wf_effect_handler:execute/2 sends execute request
Handler executes spec via apply(Module, Function, Args)
Handler sends {effect_complete, EffectId, Result} to caller
Handler terminates after execution
Unit tests verify effect executes in separate process
Unit tests verify handler process terminates after completion
user_stories.notes: Provides isolation. One process per effect (simplest error isolation).

user_stories.title: Update ln_effect:request/4 to use async handler
acceptance_criteria: ln_effect:request/4 spawns wf_effect_handler process
Sends execute request to handler
Sets pending effect status to in_flight
ln_effect:handle_info/2 handles {effect_complete, EffectId, Result} message
Calls callback_mod:resume/2 with result
Generates receipt via complete/3
Unit tests verify async handler created
Integration tests verify effect result returned to caller
user_stories.notes: Changes execution model from synchronous to asynchronous.

user_stories.title: Add effect opcodes to ln_compile
acceptance_criteria: opcode() type includes {op_effect_yield, effect_spec(), scope_id()}
opcode() type includes {op_effect_resume, label()}
ln_compile:opcode_name/1 handles effect opcodes
Unit tests verify opcodes defined
user_stories.notes: Enables bytecode representation of effect operations.

user_stories.title: Add effect constructor to ln_plan
acceptance_criteria: ln_plan:effect/1 creates {effect, Spec} plan term
plan() type includes {effect, effect_spec()}
ln_plan:validate/1 validates effect spec has module and function
Unit tests verify effect constructor
Unit tests verify validation rejects invalid specs
user_stories.notes: Enables effects in workflow plans.

user_stories.title: Implement effect compilation in ln_compile
acceptance_criteria: ln_compile:compile_plan/4 handles {effect, Spec} case
Generates op_effect_yield and op_effect_resume opcodes
Yield opcode includes effect_spec and scope_id
Resume opcode jumps to next instruction
Unit tests verify bytecode generation
Integration tests compile plan with effect
user_stories.notes: Scope tracking during compilation needed (current scope). TODO in implementation.

user_stories.title: Add effect state to ln_vm:vm_state record
acceptance_criteria: vm_state record includes effect_state field (ln_effect:state())
vm_state record includes waiting_for_effect field (effect_id())
vm_state status includes waiting_effect
ln_vm:init/1 initializes effect_state with wf_effect_handler
Unit tests verify VM state initialization
user_stories.notes: Enables VM to track effect execution.

user_stories.title: Implement op_effect_yield execution in ln_vm
acceptance_criteria: ln_vm:execute_opcode/2 handles {op_effect_yield, Spec, ScopeId}
Calls ln_effect:request/4 to request effect
Sets VM status to waiting_effect
Sets waiting_for_effect to effect ID
Returns {ok, NewState}
Unit tests verify VM yields effect request
Integration tests verify VM blocks until effect completes
user_stories.notes: Yield semantics: VM suspends execution until async handler completes.

user_stories.title: Implement op_effect_resume execution in ln_vm
acceptance_criteria: ln_vm:execute_opcode/2 handles {op_effect_resume, NextLabel}
Sets VM status to running
Clears waiting_for_effect
Sets program counter to NextLabel
Unit tests verify VM resumes after effect
user_stories.notes: Resume semantics: VM continues execution at next instruction.

user_stories.title: Implement effect completion handling in ln_vm
acceptance_criteria: ln_vm:handle_effect_complete/3 handles effect result
Calls ln_effect:complete/3 to generate receipt
Resumes VM execution via step/1
ln_vm:step/1 returns {ok, State} when status = waiting_effect
Unit tests verify VM resumes after effect complete
Integration tests verify effect executes and VM continues
user_stories.notes: Coordinates between async handler and VM execution loop.

user_stories.title: Add trace field to ln_effect:effect_state
acceptance_criteria: effect_state record includes trace field (ln_trace:state())
ln_effect:init/1 initializes trace with full level, 10000 max events
ln_effect:get_trace_events/1 returns all trace events
Unit tests verify trace state initialized
user_stories.notes: Enables observability for all effect operations.

user_stories.title: Emit effect_requested trace event in ln_effect:request/4
acceptance_criteria: ln_effect:request/4 emits effect_requested event
Event data includes idempotency_key, spec_hash, scope_id
Event includes timestamp and sequence number
Unit tests verify event emitted
Integration tests verify event in trace export
user_stories.notes: Trace events defined in ln_trace.erl:31-32 but not yet emitted.

user_stories.title: Emit effect_cached trace event for idempotent requests
acceptance_criteria: ln_effect:request/4 emits effect_cached event when idempotency hit
Event data includes idempotency_key
Unit tests verify event emitted on cache hit
Unit tests verify no event emitted on cache miss
user_stories.notes: Distinguishes between new effect execution and cached result.

user_stories.title: Emit effect_completed trace event in ln_effect:complete/3
acceptance_criteria: ln_effect:complete/3 emits effect_completed event
Event data includes causal_id, result, duration
Duration calculated as completed_at - started_at
Unit tests verify event emitted
Integration tests verify duration calculated
user_stories.notes: Provides execution time metrics.

user_stories.title: Emit effect_cancelled trace event in ln_effect:cancel_effects/2
acceptance_criteria: ln_effect:cancel_effects/2 emits effect_cancelled event
Event data includes scope_id, cancelled_count, compensated_count
cancelled_count = number of pending effects cancelled
compensated_count = number of completed effects compensated
Unit tests verify event emitted
Unit tests verify counts accurate
user_stories.notes: Tracks cancellation propagation through effect scope.
